how_to_apply: Go to the official website and open the careers or recruitment section.
Register using a valid email ID, mobile number, and PAN card.
Fill out the online application form with personal, educational, and experience details.
Upload the required documents in the specified format.
Pay the application fee online through Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI (if applicable).
Submit the online application before 28 October 2026 (05:30 p.m.).
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates must submit their applications through the online mode only; incomplete or non-submitted applications will be summarily rejected. Employees working under Central/State Governments, Autonomous Bodies, or PSUs must apply through proper channel or produce NOC at the time of examination/interview. Three referees listed by the candidate must have been associated with their training or work supervision. Selected candidates are required to serve their respective location for a minimum of 5 years before requesting a transfer. TMC reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for written tests, interviews, or skill tests based on qualifications and experience. Canvassing in any form will lead to immediate disqualification. No phone calls regarding inquiries will be entertained; queries can be sent to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: TMC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Indian Citizens, Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) cardholders, and foreign nationals who fulfill the conditions of qualifications and experience are eligible to apply, subject to necessary approvals.

rows.qualification_required: D.M. / D.N.B. (Medical Oncology) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission (NMC).
M.D./ D.N.B. (Nuclear Medicine) or equivalent degree in Nuclear Medicine recognized by NMC with minimum 3 years post M.D./ D.N.B. experience.

D.M. / D.N.B. (Paediatric Oncology / Medical Oncology) OR M.D. / D.N.B. (Paediatric) recognized by NMC. Experience not required for D.M./D.N.B; 3 years experience required for M.D./D.N.B. (Paediatrics).
M.D. / D.N.B. (Radiation Oncology / Radiotherapy) recognized by NMC with 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience.
M.D. / D.N.B. (Internal Medicine), M.D. / D.N.B. (Family Medicine), M.D. / D.N.B. (Geriatric Medicine) or equivalent recognized by NMC.
M.D. / D.N.B. (Medicine) or equivalent recognized by NMC.
M.D. / D.N.B. (Nuclear Medicine) or equivalent recognized by NMC.
M.D. / D.N.B. (Radiology / Radiodiagnosis) or equivalent recognized by NMC.
M.D. / D.N.B. (Anesthesia) or equivalent recognized by NMC.

M.B.B.S or B.D.S. or equivalent medical qualification under IMC Act 1956 AND (a) MD/DNB in Hospital/Healthcare Administration with 3 years experience in 300+ bedded hospitals OR (b) Full-time M.H.A. / M.B.A. / Post Graduate Degree equivalent to MBA by AICTE/AIU with 4 years experience in Hospital Administration in 300+ bedded hospitals.
M.Sc. (Physics) and Diploma in Radiological Physics conducted by BARC or equivalent AERB approved qualifications with Certification of Radiological Safety Officer from AERB, plus 6 years experience.
M.Sc. (Physics) and Diploma in Radiological Physics or equivalent AERB approved qualifications with Certification of Radiological Safety Officer from AERB, plus 1 year clinical experience.

M.Sc. Patient Navigation or equivalent OR Minimum Graduate with 1 year full-time Fellowship program from a leading Oncology Care Training Institute after Post Graduate Diploma in Patient Navigation, plus 3 years relevant experience.

M.Sc. (Botany/Zoology/Biochemistry/Applied Biology/Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Microbiology) with min 50% marks OR M.Tech (Biotechnology/Life Sciences) with min 50% marks and DMLT, plus 1 year experience in Cytopathology/Histopathology/IHC/Molecular Pathology.
12th Std. in Science and Diploma in Dental Mechanic Course (2 years) recognized by Dental Council of India with registration, plus 3 years experience.
10+2 in Science and certificate course of 6 months or 1 year diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology, plus 1 year experience.
10th Std plus ITI (Mechanical) 2-year full-time course with 3 years experience (or 2 years experience after ITI plus NCTVT).
Graduation with 10 years experience in lower/middle managerial position in Central/State Govt/PSU/Autonomous Bodies (8 years in Level 8 and above / Grade Pay Rs. 4800+).
Graduation with min 50% marks and 10 years experience in Finance and Accounts in Central/State Govt/PSU/Autonomous Bodies (3 years in Level 7 and above). ICWA/CA desirable.
Graduate in law with min 50% marks and 8 years work experience in Central/State Govt/PSU/Autonomous Bodies in service matters.
Graduation with min 50% marks and 8 years work experience in Finance and Accounts. ICWA/CA desirable.
Graduate with Shorthand (80 wpm) and Typewriting (40 wpm), 3 months MS Office course (exempted for IT/Computer diploma holders), and 1 year secretarial experience.
Graduation with minimum 50% marks.
10th Std. or equivalent pass with 1 year relevant experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TMC Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment drive conducted by Tata Memorial Centre (Advt. No. TMC/ADI/119/2026) to fill 72 vacancies across Medical Officer, Scientific Officer, Technician, and Administrative Officer positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 72 vacancies have been announced across various posts and hospital units under the Tata Memorial Centre.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28 October 2026 up to 05:30 p.m. (IST).

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 300/- for general candidates, while SC, ST, female candidates, PwBD, and eligible ex-servicemen are exempted from paying the fee.
